from taxii2client.v21 import Server
from stix2 import TAXIICollectionSource, Filter

server = Server(TAXII_URL, user=TAXII_USER, password=TAXII_PASSWORD)
api_root = server.api_roots[0]
collection = next(c for c in api_root.collections if c.title == "Indicators")

source = TAXIICollectionSource(collection)
indicators = source.query([Filter("type", "=", "indicator")])
caption: taxii2-client handles paging and auth; you start from a list of STIX Indicator objects.
